subject: Logic
title: Arguing Without Fallacies
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Arguing Without Fallacies.

hook.text: Winning arguments with fallacies is easy. Winning them honestly? That takes real skill.

buildup.text: Start with clear premises. Make sure each one is supported and relevant to the conclusion.

discovery.text: Use evidence, not emotion. Acknowledge counterpoints. Show why your view holds despite objections.

twist.text: The strongest arguments steelman the opposition first—then show why evidence still favors your side.

climax.text: Clean arguments earn trust. People remember the person who convinced them fairly.

quiz.question: What is the foundation of a fallacy-free argument?
